settings.text: Your body relies on hormones like a complex messaging system. These hormone messages control everything from your energy and mood to your period and sleep.

settings.text: But to send these messages clearly, your body needs specific nutrients like those from organ meats – the same organs our ancestors ate regularly.

settings.text: Modern diets have stripped these crucial nutrients from our food, and our bodies are suffering.

settings.text: It’s like trying to send important texts with a broken phone – the messages get lost, scrambled, or never arrive at all.
